bundle.shortDescription: Every git repo on your machine, as a list and as a map
bundle.longDescription: Atlas — one scan of every git repo on your machine, shown two ways. The list is branch, sync state, changed files and last commit at a glance. The map renders the same repos as an isometric city: directories are terraces, files are buildings sized by their code, coloured by language, and flagged coral when the working tree is dirty.
